Garden House Suite Recommended

Garden House Suite: 1.The Garden House Suites, with 80 m² (approx. 861 sq ft) of interior space, are an invitation to absolute serenity, set within the gardens of Parque Terra Nostra. Located approximately 250 meters (about 820 feet) from the main building of Terra Nostra Garden Hotel, these suites offer an experience where privacy, comfort, and a deep connection to nature come together in perfect harmony.

Breakfast is served at TN Restaurant, in the hotel’s main building, where guests also have access to all services and facilities—ensuring a complete and seamless experience under the Terra Nostra Garden Hotel signature.

Designed for long stays or guests who prioritize exclusivity and tranquility, the Garden House Suites are known for their intimate and elegant atmosphere. They offer effortless access to all hotel amenities while preserving the privacy and calm of a more secluded retreat.
